issues.title: Repository and package scaffold
acceptanceCriteria: TypeScript CLI project targets the documented Node baseline and locks dependencies.
Final license, maturity status and supported-path documentation are ready before publication.
No install command or success badge claims a nonexistent runtime.

issues.title: Canonical contracts and stable IDs
acceptanceCriteria: Config, source, decision, obligation, case and evidence records have versioned schemas.
Required/candidate/deferred/excluded states and obligation-to-case roll-up are explicit.
Illustrative data and empty required scope cannot satisfy a gate.

issues.title: CLI initialization and diagnostics
acceptanceCriteria: Init is idempotent, records ownership and preserves user files.
Doctor is read-only and reports missing runner/config/source access clearly.
Machine output and stable error/exit-code contracts work.

issues.title: Local context import and provenance
acceptanceCriteria: Markdown/text sources retain original locators, hashes and capture metadata.
Unreadable and partially imported inputs remain visible.
Raw private context and artifacts are not automatically committed.
issues.validationNotes: See docs/STATUS.md for local implementation evidence and remaining original acceptance work.

issues.title: Agent-normalized document and ticket import
acceptanceCriteria: Existing agent tools can supply normalized source text with origin and extraction limits.
Summaries and excerpts remain distinguishable from complete extraction.
No new connector authentication or credential copying is required by the alpha.
issues.validationNotes: See docs/STATUS.md for local implementation evidence and remaining original acceptance work.

issues.title: Bounded feature brief and source conflicts
acceptanceCriteria: A compact bundle links relevant rules, actors, outcomes and exclusions to sources.
Conflicting rules and unreviewed important source sections are explicit.
Current implementation and timestamps do not silently override product authority.
issues.validationNotes: See docs/STATUS.md for local implementation evidence and remaining original acceptance work.

issues.title: Decision memory and three-question limit
acceptanceCriteria: Zero to three distinct material questions can be asked per feature revision.
Unchanged answers are reused and revisions cannot evade the limit.
Unresolved consequential intent remains incomplete after the question budget is exhausted.
issues.validationNotes: See docs/STATUS.md for local implementation evidence and remaining original acceptance work.

issues.title: Bounded scenario proposal policy
acceptanceCriteria: Equivalent cases are deduplicated and distinct important outcomes are prioritized.
Source-backed requirements and inferred optional suggestions remain separate.
Low-impact deferred concerns produce at most one collapsed notice and do not repeat without relevant changes.
issues.validationNotes: See docs/STATUS.md for local implementation evidence and remaining original acceptance work.

issues.title: Plan validation, freezing and revisions
acceptanceCriteria: Plan apply freezes stable obligations/cases and a scope digest without another model call.
Every required outcome has source/decision/invariant provenance.
Scope/denominator changes are recorded and cannot hide a failing required case.

issues.title: Synthetic app and resettable seeded regressions
acceptanceCriteria: A tiny TypeScript import fixture has documented launch/reset steps and synthetic data.

issues.title: Native test reuse and generation recipe
acceptanceCriteria: Existing fixtures/tests are reused before new tests are generated.
Normal Playwright files carry stable case IDs and meaningful outcome mappings.
Tests run directly through Playwright without a CaseHatch model workflow.

issues.title: Playwright execution and evidence reporter
acceptanceCriteria: Collected suite bindings cover every selected required case/project variant exactly as declared.

issues.title: Evidence revision and freshness rules
acceptanceCriteria: Evidence identifies actual tested tree, plan, test/config/context and fixture fingerprints.
Changed relevant inputs invalidate evidence; dirty state is not attributed to a different pushed commit.

issues.title: Coverage and readiness evaluator
acceptanceCriteria: Required obligation roll-up requires all required concrete case/project variants.
Execution coverage and passing share remain separate; 0/0 is NO_SCOPE.

issues.title: Quiet terminal and canonical reports
